_comment: run_review_checklist team overrides: copy this file next to the .PrjPcb (or into the root of the Git repository above it) as review_checklists.json, or into a review_checklists folder there under any name ending in .json.
disable: item ids of the bundled checklists to leave out (run_review_checklist with no checklist lists the checklists; README 'Review checklists' explains the item format).
add_sections / add: sections and items for an existing checklist, named by 'checklist'. Item ids are unique across all checklists.
checklists: whole checklists; one with a bundled id (schematic, pcb, release, bom) replaces it, a new id adds one.
Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every value is checked: a problem is reported with this file and the place in it.
name: Example team review rules
